description: Bookings, modifications, and cancellations from the brand website, app, contact center, online travel agencies, and global distribution systems for all 750 hotels (about 38 million transactions a year)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Every hour down loses bookings for all 750 hotels; franchise agreements commit the CRS to 99.9% monthly availability; reservations lost are rarely rebooked with the brand
manual_workaround: Hotels take direct phone bookings on paper and enter them later; channel connections queue messages for up to 4 hours; online travel agencies close availability after that
dependent_third_parties: Distribution switch vendor; Cloud provider A; payment gateway
dependent_people_or_facilities: Reservations and distribution team; CRS engineering on call
quantified_impact_basis: About $1.9 million of displaced bookings at owned and leased hotels, about $0.6 million of franchise and reservation fees on lost system bookings, about $0.8 million of franchisee and owner service credits, and about $0.9 million of recovery and overtime cost
franchise_or_acquisition_dependency: All 640 franchised hotels and SL-2 clients depend on the CRS
single_points_of_failure: Single CRS instance (active-passive across two regions)

business_process: Front desk operations: check-in, check-out, folios, and night audit
description: Arrivals, room assignment, folio posting, and night audit through the brand cloud PMS at 741 hotels
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Arrivals cannot be checked in or rooms assigned without the PMS after the printed downtime reports go stale (about one shift); guests stranded at the desk
manual_workaround: PMS downtime reports printed every 4 hours (arrivals, in-house, room status); paper registration cards; manual key encoding from the lock front end
quantified_impact_basis: About 15% leakage of daily room revenue at owned and leased hotels ($0.57 million), service credits to franchisees and owners ($0.6 million), walk-in and early departure losses ($0.9 million), and overtime and back-entry ($0.5 million)
franchise_or_acquisition_dependency: 9 resorts on the seller's PMS run separately (see BP-17)

business_process: Card payment authorization, tokenization, and settlement
description: Tokenization, detokenization for authorization, and settlement for the CRS, PMS, booking engine, and front desk terminals (about 6.2 million active tokens)
process_owner: Director of Payments and PCI Compliance
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Without tokenization, CRS guarantees and PMS charges stop; front desks cannot authorize deposits; settlement delays cost interest and chargebacks
manual_workaround: Front desk P2PE terminals authorize directly through the gateway; CRS takes bookings without guarantee for up to 4 hours and collects cards at arrival
dependent_third_parties: Payment gateway and processor; P2PE solution provider; Cloud provider A
quantified_impact_basis: Unguaranteed no-shows and late cancellations (about $0.9 million), delayed settlement and chargebacks ($0.7 million), lost prepaid bookings ($1.1 million), and recovery cost ($0.4 million)
franchise_or_acquisition_dependency: Franchised hotels detokenize CRS guarantees through this service
single_points_of_failure: Single tokenization service and card vault; one primary gateway

business_process: Guest room access (door locks and key encoding)
description: Key card encoding at the front desk and mobile keys; lock servers at 110 company-operated hotels
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Guest safety and security: guests cannot enter rooms and lost keys cannot be voided; fire and life safety egress is mechanical and not affected
manual_workaround: Emergency master key procedure with security escort; lock front-end offline encoding for up to 24 hours on some models
quantified_impact_basis: Room moves and compensation, security staffing, and goodwill credits across affected hotels
franchise_or_acquisition_dependency: Franchised hotels run their own lock systems
single_points_of_failure: 31 lock servers on unsupported operating systems

description: Restaurant, bar, room service, and banquet sales at 264 outlets in company-operated hotels
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Outlets can run on cash and room charge for one meal period; card acceptance stops on the legacy POS if its servers are down
manual_workaround: Paper checks and room charges posted later; P2PE handhelds in standalone mode at cloud POS outlets
dependent_third_parties: Cloud POS vendor; legacy POS vendor; P2PE solution provider
quantified_impact_basis: About 60% of owned and leased food and beverage revenue for one day ($1.42 million) partly recovered later

business_process: Contact center reservations and guest service
description: About 650 agents taking reservations, loyalty, and service calls, with tone-masking card capture
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 7% of system bookings come through the contact center; long outages push callers to online travel agencies
manual_workaround: Calls routed to hotels; the website and app take bookings
dependent_third_parties: Contact center platform vendor; tone-masking service provider; telephony carriers
dependent_people_or_facilities: Contact center sites in Florida and Texas
quantified_impact_basis: Lost and displaced bookings plus agent idle time

description: Member enrollment, sign-in, points earning and redemption for 14.2 million members
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Members cannot redeem or see points; co-brand card partner commitments; points ledger accuracy is a financial liability
manual_workaround: Points posted later from PMS folios; redemption bookings honored manually by the contact center
dependent_third_parties: Loyalty platform vendor; co-brand card issuer (data feed)
quantified_impact_basis: Member compensation and partner penalties plus displaced redemption stays
franchise_or_acquisition_dependency: Franchised hotels post points through the PMS

description: PMS tenant administration, CRS access, managed property network, and technology help desk for 640 franchised hotels
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Franchise agreements and the SL-1 service commitments set response and availability terms; franchisees depend on the company for PMS and network
manual_workaround: Hotel-level downtime procedures; help desk on backup telephony
dependent_people_or_facilities: Franchise technology services team; help desk
quantified_impact_basis: Service credits and fee waivers under franchise agreements plus help desk surge cost
franchise_or_acquisition_dependency: Directly serves 640 franchised hotels (410 on the managed network)
single_points_of_failure: Network hubs in two colocation data centers

description: CRS and booking engine services for about 180 unbranded independent hotels
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Client agreements commit 99.9% availability and 4-hour recovery
manual_workaround: Clients take phone bookings on paper
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider A; distribution switch vendor
quantified_impact_basis: Service credits and client churn risk

business_process: Digital guest services (website, app, mobile check-in, digital key)
description: Brand website and app, mobile check-in with ID verification, digital keys
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Bookings move to other channels; digital keys fall back to plastic keys
manual_workaround: Booking through the contact center and online travel agencies; plastic keys at the desk
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider A; app store distribution; ID verification vendor
quantified_impact_basis: Shifted bookings at higher channel cost plus lost direct bookings

description: Demand forecasting and daily rate recommendations published to the CRS and channels for company-operated hotels and 212 franchised hotels that subscribe
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Rates can be held at the last published values for several days; emergency pricing rules must keep working during declared emergencies
manual_workaround: Revenue managers set rates manually in the CRS
quantified_impact_basis: Estimated revenue per available room loss from static pricing

description: Group and event bookings, deposits, and banquet event orders
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Contracts and deposits can wait a day or two; event-day changes need current orders
manual_workaround: Printed banquet event orders; deposits taken later through payment links
quantified_impact_basis: Delayed deposits and lost group leads

description: HVAC and energy management, elevator monitoring, and IPTV head ends at company-operated hotels (life safety systems run independently)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Guest comfort and equipment protection; heat in Florida and Texas summers
manual_workaround: Engineering runs equipment in manual mode

description: Payroll for 12,000 employees and timekeeping at 110 hotels
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Wage payment timing laws; hourly staff rely on on-time pay
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll with adjustments next cycle

business_process: Financial close, owner reporting, franchise fee billing, and SEC reporting
description: Monthly close, owner statements for 72 managed hotels, franchise fee billing from CRS and PMS revenue data, and quarterly SEC reporting
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Quarter-end SEC filing deadlines tighten the MTD to 48 hours in the close window; management agreements set owner reporting dates
manual_workaround: Manual journal entries from bank and PMS exports
quantified_impact_basis: Late owner reports and fee disputes
franchise_or_acquisition_dependency: Franchise fees depend on CRS and PMS data

description: Guest internet and IPTV at company-operated hotels

business_process: Operations at the 9 resorts on the seller's legacy systems
description: Reservations, front desk, payments, and point of sale at 9 resorts under the transition services agreement
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Resort revenue is high per room; the transition services agreement states a 24-hour RTO and nightly backups (24-hour RPO), which do not meet the targets
manual_workaround: Paper downtime procedures supplied by the seller
dependent_systems: Seller's legacy PMS and network; SYS-09 (partial)
dependent_third_parties: Seller under the transition services agreement; legacy PMS vendor
quantified_impact_basis: About $0.6 million of resort revenue per day at risk plus guest compensation
